name.description: Display name of the model, e.g. Claude Opus 5.5.

apiId.description: Id of the model on the provider's side, as its API expects it, e.g. claude-opus-5-5 or llama3.1:8b.

protocol.description: API protocol the model is called with, one of its provider's connections: anthropic-messages, openai-chat-completions or openai-responses. Its settings are written in that protocol's vocabulary.

title: AICo LLM model
description: Configuration of a model served by an LLM provider, in .aico/llm-providers/<provider-id>/models/<model-id>/config.json.
